reason: The description closely matches the implementation: it explains that the function performs time-based maintenance before returning the current state, generation, and counts age; it correctly covers the closed-state expiry rollover, the closed-state bucket growth path, and the open-to-half-open transition when expiry has passed. It is slightly imperfect because it describes bucket growth as based on the "current age" without making explicit that growth only happens in the closed state when expiry did not trigger and when there are already at least two buckets, and it does not mention that no maintenance occurs for half-open state. These are minor omissions rather than substantive mismatches.
missing_functionality: Does not explicitly note that no action is taken when the breaker is in half-open state.
Does not make fully explicit that bucket growth in closed state is skipped if expiry triggered a new generation first.
